art.subject: Red-footed Booby (Sula sula), adult white morph: plumage white, sometimes with a faint golden-yellow wash on the head and neck; primaries and secondaries black, forming a black rear half of the wing; a black patch on the underwing at the base of the primaries; tail white. Bill pale blue-grey with a pink base; bare facial skin pink and blue around the bill base and eye; legs and feet bright red.
art.pose: perched upright on a rocky islet, gripping with bright red feet, side view
art.scene: rocky islet in the open sea off Jeju in late summer, blue water and broken cloud; no people, buildings or text
views: adult white morph, side view perched upright on a rocky islet: slim booby with a long pointed bill, white plumage, black primaries and secondaries forming a black rear edge to the folded wing, white tail, bright red feet

adult white morph, in flight seen squarely from below: head, body and tail in one line, long narrow pointed wings spread straight out to the sides to their full span with a slight bend at the wrist, white body and wing coverts, black flight feathers, white wedge-shaped tail, red feet tucked under the tail

juvenile, in flight seen squarely from below: long narrow pointed wings spread straight out to the sides to their full span, brown overall with darker brown wings, paler belly and a darker chest band, wedge-shaped tail, pinkish feet tucked under the tail
art.build: Smallest booby, clearly smaller and slimmer than Masked Booby, about the size of a large gull, with long pointed wings. Head rounded, neck short. Bill shorter than the head, conical and sharply pointed. Legs short, feet large, webbed and bright red in adults; it perches on branches and rocks. In flight long, narrow, pointed wings and a long wedge-shaped tail.
avoid: Do not paint a black tail or black face mask — those are Masked Booby; the white-morph Red-footed Booby has a white tail and no black mask.
Do not paint yellow, grey or blue feet; adult feet are bright red.
Do not paint the dark brown head and breast of Brown Booby (Sula leucogaster).
Do not paint a yellow bill; it is pale blue-grey with a pink base.
